metadata.description: Claude Code mods by nahuel893: openskin, an OpenCode-style look for the transcript; command-register, copy the shell commands Claude gives from a numbered list; board, a done, pending and waiting list per project.

plugins.name: openskin
plugins.description: An OpenCode-style look for the Claude Code transcript, with framed shell commands; every color configurable.

plugins.name: command-register
plugins.description: A numbered register of the shell commands Claude gives: /cc lists them to copy one with its digit.

plugins.name: board
plugins.description: A living board per project: /board rewrites the list of what is done, pending and waiting on your decision from the conversation.
